summary: New experimental component count — the fourth of ADR 0028's owned motion components. A number formatted with Intl.NumberFormat (format and locale props), one span per character, matched to the previous value from the right; only changed characters move. A changed character remounts and arrives through @starting-style on --ui-duration-base, rising --ui-space-xs × --ui-motion-travel when the value grew and dropping when it shrank; an aria-hidden ghost beside it in the same grid cell draws the old character with ::before content from data-char and fades on --ui-duration-fast. Generated content is never text, so the element's text is the plain value at every frame — the digit-debris trap app-motion warns about cannot happen. TextSwap's clock and Presence's rise reused; no new token; tabular figures; first render still. Designed and built overnight without review: the direction rule and right-aligned place matching are badged Derived on the sheet (Components - Drafts). Three probes were run (ghost rendered as text; travel removed; direction ignored), each failing its named test.
